notes:
Summary: Velox is a mid-market helpdesk SaaS provider focused on enterprise customers (fin/healthcare verticals). Goal: automate ticket/email summarization + auto-tagging to reduce TTR and speed agent triage. Primary systems: Zendesk (agents use macros & triggers), Freshdesk in two resold accounts.

Key constraints and asks:
- Must support Zendesk macro-driven tool-calls (update ticket fields, add internal notes) and webhook-based workflows.
- Data residency required for eu customers; cannot export PII out of region: "can't have PII leave region" said VP Eng.
- Latency SLO for agent assist: p95 < 250ms for live assist; background/batch summarization can be slower (p95 < 3s).
- Availability target: 99.95% at peak; need graceful degradation and fallbacks to smaller model variants.
- Cost sensitivity: want a mix of hosted for quick rollout + Dedicated for predictable spikes (product launches generate 5-10x daily volumes).
- Model preference: open quantized models OK; want recommendations for batching/caching and quantization profile from Redwood Optimize.

POC proposal discussed:
- 4-week POC: ingest 100k anonymized tickets, run nightly batch summarization + real-time agent-assist on staging.
- Outcomes: measure accuracy vs existing templates, tagging precision/recall, latency under concurrency (500 concurrent agents), cost per 1k tickets.
- Deliverables: sample integration with Zendesk macros (create internal note + apply tag), mapping doc for tag taxonomy, short eval report.

Quotes / call notes:
- AE: "they want to see production spike handling — not just demo numbers."
- VP Product: "If we can cut first-touch triage time by 40% we reallocate 6 FTEs."

Technical notes / risks:
- Need SAML metadata before infra proof-of-concept.
- Legal wants explicit retention controls and deletion flow for EU requests.
- Security requested a small-scale air-gapped test for on-prem parity; likely later phase.

Ask from Redwood: provide anonymized latency and throughput benchmarks for similar workloads; draft MSA with residency addendum; SE to run spike test (simulate 10x launch traffic).
